title: Joint Qualified Officer (JQO) (I) (Col to Maj) FMOS, DC M&RA
raw_text:
2.     MOS 9702, Joint Qualified Officer (JQO) (I) (Col to Maj) FMOS, DC M&RA

    a. Summary. Joint Qualified Officers (JQO) Level III are officers
normally in the grade of major and above who have been awarded the JQO
designation by the Secretary of Defense per Chapter 38 of reference (ao).
The designation of JQO is the recognition for significant joint matters
experience and joint education that enables an officer to function as a joint
matters expert. This MOS appears in the special information/joint block on
the master brief sheet on the Basic Individual Record. This MOS will never



                                          1-365                      Enclosure (1)
 1148                                                               NAVMC 1200.1L



appear as a primary or additional. The Under Secretary of Defense, Personnel
and Readiness is the approval authority.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Must be in the grade of O-4 or above to be designated JQO Level
III.

        (2) Must have the approved JQO designation by USD (P&R) to receive
the 9702 MOS.

        (3) Must be identified as eligible for Joint Qualified Officer Level
III through the Joint Duty Assignment Management Information System.

        (4) Must be nominated by the Military Service upon successful
completion of the joint qualification, education, and quality criteria for
JQO designation.

        (5) Must have been assigned to a standard joint duty assignment (S-
JDA) or gain experience points through joint matters experience. S-JDAs only
include those positions that are on the Joint Duty Assignment List.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Must be awarded full joint duty credit through an S-JDA, accrual
of 24 joint qualification points, or a combination of S-JDA and E-JDA time to
equal 24 points/months.

            (a) An officer serving in an S-JDA is prohibited from using time
served in their current position to achieve the requisite 24 points required
for Level III until the officer completes at least 22 months in the position.

            (b) A recency requirement of a minimum of 12 months of aggregated
time in a position where joint experience is awarded while in the grade, for
pay purposes, of O-4 or higher. Due to the 12-month recency requirement,
officers may need more than 24 total points to qualify for Level III.
Officers must be an O-4 (for pay purposes) for at least 1 day while filling
an S-JDA in order for the full time in the S-JDA to count towards the 12-
month recency requirement. Officers with approved Experience-based Joint
Duty Assignment experiences receive day-for-day credit for time as an O-4
(for pay purposes) towards the 12-month recency requirement.

            (2) Must successfully complete JPME Phase I and JPME Phase II.

        (3) Must have a minimum of 18 points must come from joint duty or
experience. A maximum of 6 discretionary points may be derived from joint
training, joint exercises, and education/training courses other than JPME.

        (4) JQO designation is required for appointment as an O-7 (Active-
duty officers only). See DoDI 1300.19 Change 1 for Scientific, Technical,
Professional, and Good of Service Waivers.

       d.   Duties

        (1) The duties will be as prescribed and designated by the command or
activity to which assigned.

            (2) JQO Level III can be assigned to Joint Critical positions.



                                        1-366                        Enclosure (1)
 1148                                                                NAVMC 1200.1L



        (3) All JQO Level IIIs must be assigned to an S-JDA as their next
duty assignment following graduation of National Defense University (as
defined in CJCSI 1800.01 Series) unless waived on a case-by-case basis by
USD(P&R).

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Officer Military Training/Reporting/Special Duty Code (no related SOC) 00-
0002.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
